report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300 s window (policy-window-1, 2026-09-27T20:02:18Z–20:07:18Z) the error signal attributed to checkout is concentrated in checkout's outbound gRPC span oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart and in cart's server span POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart: both report an increase of 8.1235 ERROR calls over the window, and the error status descriptions name cart storage / redis/valkey connectivity ('Can't access cart storage ... Wasn't able to connect to redis ... ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected()'), with checkout-side spans carrying rpc.grpc.status_code 9. Checkout's client-side latency to CartService in the same window was orders of magnitude larger than to its other dependencies (mean 23806 ms vs 2.1–24.8 ms; p95 EmptyCart 10000 ms vs 4.75–68.75 ms), but no baseline window was delivered, so this is a contemporaneous cross-dependency contrast, not an established latency trend. Checkout's own PlaceOrder span shows 0 ERROR increase and rpc.grpc.status_code 0 in sampled spans, so 'elevated checkout errors' is supported only at the EmptyCart sub-span/dependency level, not for PlaceOrder itself. Payment, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email show no failing spans or non-zero error-rate increases in the sampled/aggregated views. The cart-side storage failure is consistent with a redis/valkey reachability problem, but the cause of that unavailability is not observed in this Run; cart's server-side duration histogram returned no data, and several trace views were truncated/incomplete, so the picture is sampled rather than complete.

claims.text: Checkout's outbound span oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart and cart's inbound span POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart both report an increase of 8.1235 ERROR-status calls over the 300 s window, while checkout's own oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder shows 0 ERROR increase.

Failing EmptyCart spans carry cart-storage/redis error text. Checkout-side oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart spans report 'Can't access cart storage. System.ApplicationException: Wasn't able to connect to redis ... ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected() ... EmptyCartAsync' with otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 9, and cart-side POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart spans report StatusCode='FailedPrecondition' with the same redis detail. Trace ids carrying these spans include 2ceaf16231cf7cd9c41fe4802c618fee (EmptyCart duration 146323793 us), 981a0eccfc86f9628f2efdedb00e41f0 (51959457 us), 16fe13b4cf77aada622de04eac46f032 (47127543 us), 63ed0ba285e32676a7d88a14a3c94879 (40675272 us), 3de9a5233072a897237d8c16cd1bbf85 (35991304 us), 76876d4d9d76e2832bc9e33005266343 (28925638 us) and f0d67e8747ceb9892882fd84142fa216 (28362334 us).

Within the same window, checkout's client-side mean duration by dependency was 23806.4 ms for oteldemo.CartService versus 24.75 ms (PaymentService), 12.23 ms (ShippingService), 6.29 ms (CurrencyService) and 2.09 ms (ProductCatalogService); p95 was 10000 ms for CartService/EmptyCart versus 68.75 ms (ShippingService/GetQuote), 46.88 ms (PaymentService/Charge), 23.13 ms (CartService/GetCart), 20.13 ms (CurrencyService/Convert), 8.0 ms (ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) and 4.75 ms (ShippingService/ShipOrder). These are contemporaneous comparisons inside one window; no baseline window was delivered.

In the dependency metric view, only cart's POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart carried STATUS_CODE_ERROR (0.027/s rate, 8.1235 increase); cart's HGET, HMSET, EXPIRE, POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, POST /oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and flagd ResolveBoolean series appeared only with non-error statuses.

Sampled spans from payment, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email in the window show successful statuses: payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge rpc.grpc.status_code 0 (durations 8935, 8383, 6161, 4895, 3042, 2289 us), product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct rpc.grpc.status_code 0, currency Currency/Convert otel.status_code OK (durations 7467 down to 254 us), shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder rpc.grpc.status_code 0 with HTTP 200, and email POST /send_order_confirmation http.status_code 200 (e.g. 16643 us).

Checkout's server-side mean rpc duration for oteldemo.CheckoutService was 57747.55 ms in this window, and sampled checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans lasted 146323793 us (trace 2ceaf16231cf7cd9c41fe4802c618fee), 52066119 us (981a0eccfc86f9628f2efdedb00e41f0), 47186164 us (16fe13b4cf77aada622de04eac46f032), 40812231 us (63ed0ba285e32676a7d88a14a3c94879), 36040630 us (3de9a5233072a897237d8c16cd1bbf85), 29011253 us (76876d4d9d76e2832bc9e33005266343) and 28537682 us (f0d67e8747ceb9892882fd84142fa216). No baseline window is available, so no trend is asserted.

User-facing edge errors accompany the cart failures: frontend-proxy 'ingress' reports a 7.5 ERROR increase and load-generator POST a 6.25 ERROR increase and GET 1.25 over the window; in trace 76876d4d9d76e2832bc9e33005266343 a load-generator POST span (15001642 us) and a frontend-proxy ingress span (15000355 us) both carry http.status_code 504 and otel.status_code ERROR, while the same trace's frontend POST /api/checkout span reports http.status_code 200.

The claim that checkout's own PlaceOrder operation is erroring is not supported by this window: oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder ERROR increase is 0 in both the checkout-span and whole-fleet error views, checkout's PlaceOrder spans in the sample carry rpc.grpc.status_code 0 without error tags, and an email POST /send_order_confirmation and shipping ShipOrder span complete successfully inside those same traces.

Rejected as unsupported: that checkout's errors originate in payment, product-catalog, currency, shipping or email. In this window the ERROR-increase view reports 0 for checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote and ShipOrder, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, payment GET/dns.lookup/tcp.connect, and product-catalog GetProduct; sampled spans for those dependencies show rpc.grpc.status_code 0, currency otel.status_code OK and email HTTP 200, whereas the only non-zero checkout-related error series is CartService/EmptyCart (8.1235) plus cart's matching inbound span.

The EmptyCart failures are most consistent with cart being unable to reach its redis/valkey storage backend: the failing spans come from cart's own inbound EmptyCart handler with 'FailedPrecondition'/'Wasn't able to connect to redis' detail at ValkeyCartStore.EnsureRedisConnected/EmptyCartAsync, and the long multi-second-to-minute EmptyCart durations match repeated connect-retry behaviour, while the redis/valkey backend itself is not directly observed in this Run.

Treat cart→redis/valkey reachability as the primary lead: have a human inspect cart storage connectivity, valkey/redis health and cart retry/timeout configuration, and separately determine why checkout's PlaceOrder still returns gRPC status 0 and 0 ERROR increase while its EmptyCart dependency span fails with code 9.

gaps: No baseline or comparison window was queried or delivered, so no latency trend or regression-versus-normal can be established; only contemporaneous comparisons inside the single 300 s window are reportable.

Cart server-side latency is unknown: the histogram_quantile query over rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name='cart'} returned status no_data (0de12cf7-962b-475e-8111-8290c83af619-t6:0a4a6135-90f2-4674-a0e3-f715a9911f75), so server-side duration distribution for cart and any network-vs-server split cannot be quantified.

Trace evidence is a sampled subset: view 0de12cf7-962b-475e-8111-8290c83af619-t0:883652fb-a0e6-4310-bb41-98e2be777e52 is incomplete ('backend returned as many traces as requested; more may exist') and truncated, and 0de12cf7-962b-475e-8111-8290c83af619-t1:44afa9a5-15d9-47fb-b29a-72140b199a04 is truncated; the delivered spans are therefore not a complete call chain or a full request count.

The redis/valkey backend is not directly observed: no redis/valkey service spans or metrics were queried, so the cause of the reported storage unavailability (capacity, restarts, network policy, config) remains unknown.

Metric series coverage is partial: several services/operations have no ERROR series at all in the returned error view (e.g. cart GetCart/AddItem, email, shipping, currency, checkout PlaceOrder rows present only as other statuses), and absence of a series must be treated as unknown rather than zero for those operations.

The relationship between the frontend-proxy/load-generator error increases and the EmptyCart failure is temporal co-occurrence only; at least one sampled trace shows frontend POST /api/checkout returning 200 inside the same trace that shows a 504 at frontend-proxy/load-generator, and this inconsistency is not explained by available evidence.
Why checkout's PlaceOrder reports gRPC status 0 and 0 ERROR increase while its EmptyCart client span fails with code 9 is not resolved by the available spans, metrics or absence of logs.
No log, event, deployment-change or infrastructure/node evidence was delivered, so fault-injection or config-change timing cannot be assessed.
next_steps: Have a human inspect cart's redis/valkey storage connectivity and health (plus cart timeout/retry settings) and correlate with the 20:02–20:07 window.
Determine whether checkout is expected to swallow EmptyCart failures, and whether the reported 'elevated checkout errors' page/alert is defined on the EmptyCart sub-span attribute or on PlaceOrder.
Collect a comparable baseline window for checkout and cart latency/error rates before asserting any trend or severity.
Confirm payment, product-catalog, currency, shipping and email health with service-side metrics (e.g. their own error counters and duration histograms) rather than the sampled trace view alone.
Review whether the 504s at frontend-proxy/load-generator share the same root cause as the EmptyCart failures or represent a separate timeout path.
